[![Platform Compatibility](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fswiftpackageindex.com%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fgoogleapis%2Fswift-google-cloud-baremetalsolution-v2%2Fbadge%3Ftype%3Dplatforms)](https://swiftpackageindex.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-baremetalsolution-v2)

Provides ways to manage Bare Metal Solution hardware installed in a
regional extension located near a Google Cloud data center.

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `BareMetalSolutionClient`: Performs management operations on Bare Metal Solution servers.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `BareMetalSolutionClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudBareMetalSolutionV2
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(parent: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudBareMetalSolutionV2.BareMetalSolutionClient()
  let items = client.listInstancesByItems(
    request: ListInstancesRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "\(parent)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-baremetalsolution-v2` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-baremetalsolution-v2.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudBareMetalSolutionV2` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudBareMetalSolutionV2 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-baremetalsolution-v2
```
